entries.prompt:
Correct ONE actual isolated NECA Celtic Series14final2015mask source-view study. REFERENCE1 is the official white catalogue and SOLE CAMERA authority: keep its exact tilted THREE-QUARTER view, inclination, dome, proportions and visible side. REFERENCE2 is the former isolated A identifying the shell, but it has a proven extraction error. REFERENCE3and4 are additional official photos of this exact edition: they reveal living red-brown flesh and tiny ivory fangs behind real apertures in the worn silver mask. They corroborate component ownership only, not a new camera to combine.

TARGETED CORRECTION: remove ALL the FALSE COPPER/BRONZE LOUVERS AND RIB INSERTS invented inside cheek and central apertures in previousA. They are not proven metal parts; in the real photo, red-brown contents and little white pointed fangs belong to the living wearer BEHIND OPENINGS. Remove all that organic content too. Keep only the actual SILVER HARD-SHELL APERTURE EDGES in the true source positions/shapes and leave each genuine opening visibly EMPTY TRANSPARENT ALPHA, not black solid fill and not new grille mesh.

Preserve the two real rounded cheek openings below the lenses, the narrow central vertical open slot where the source exposes brown contents between its silver fluted bars, and restore the SMALL REAL LOWER OVAL OPENING on the lower near/image-left snout lobe visible in reference1 below the large near cheek opening. This low oval is a hole edged by rigid silver, NOT a copper plug or a separate living eye. It was incorrectly smoothed over in previousA. Preserve only openings actually visible at reference1camera; do not invent a hidden far-side lower hole. The small temple circular dark mechanical feature up beside the near eye remains as reference1 shows; do not convert every black optical/mechanical recess indiscriminately to alpha. Two eye lenses stay pale silver-grey SOLID opaque material.

Keep all other real silver sculpture unchanged: broad flattened rounded dome and layered oval crown rim, true top notch without wearer cranium, curved brow and pale lenses, actual silver cheek housings and the complete parallel FLUTED SILVER SNOUT BARS/lobes at their real source count/shape. The fluted metal bars themselves must NOT be removed; only flesh/fangs/fantasy copper blocking their genuine holes goes away. No new tusks, horns, rune, vent, tooth, hidden back or interior mechanism. Preserve near-front THREE-QUARTER DOWN/TILTED camera of reference1and previousA, no frontalization/forced symmetry or stretching. Catalogue silver-grey weathered paint, no copper recolour, dramatic cyan light or mirror chrome.

Remove all dreadlocks/bands, skin/living head/eyes/mandibles, collar/neck/body/armor/cannon, hoses outside mask, trophies/weapons and full background. One whole rigid detached mask, genuine transparent alpha INCLUDING the real empty apertures, no support/floor/cast-shadow plane/text. Request1254x1254square if supported,78–80percent largest axis,8–12percent clear margins all sides, no clipping. This is a photographed licensed toy-edition candidate, not canon/human/runtime certification.

notes: Targeted correction of source-owned aperture edges and wearer exclusion, same primary3/4camera.
Real lens materials kept opaque; true empty cheek/central/lower openings alpha, silver fluted bars preserved.

limitations: 1300px-tall official final-production photograph, full mask visible in a mild three-quarter pose; exact lens depth and hidden side not known.

Native visible minimum margin is below requested8–12percent; no edge clipping observed and no crop/resize/raster change performed.

attempts.prompt:
Create ONE isolated rigid mask A from the actual photographed licensed toy edition: NECA Celtic Series14 final production2015, licensed Alien vs. Predator2004 toy edition. Reference1 controls the visible source camera, tilt, sculpture, asymmetries, proportions, paint palette and wear. Other references if present only corroborate this same edition, not another view to merge. Do not substitute a PHG interpretation, another edition or a generic Predator mask.

Use ONLY the silver biomask worn by the standing figure, keeping the actual visible slightly tilted THREE-QUARTER source view; do not frontalize or rotate it. Preserve its wide flattened rounded metallic dome and layered oval crown rim, side temple raised housing, the actual narrow silver/pale-grey solid eye lens, sculpted silver cheek/respirator ribs, genuine round recessed side port with its dark/rust-coloured inner element, and the lower parallel ridged snout with its small actual red/brown vent interiors. Retain only real silver-grey weathered paint and those restrained inset colours; do not invent text/glyphs, horns, biological teeth or a new circular mouth. The curved white/grey tubes visible outside the mask beside the figure's shoulder belong to the wearer equipment and must be removed with the black dreadlocks, neck, cannon and armor; do not include loose external hoses as mask extensions.

Remove every wearer component: living skin/cranium, eyes or teeth behind the mask, biological mandibles, all dreadlocks and their bands, neck, collar, body/chest/shoulder armor, shoulder cannon, cables/hoses belonging to the wearer, hands, weapons, mannequin/stand, scene/catalogue background and any unrelated separate heads or accessories. Keep only the complete rigid mask sculpture. Preserve solid lens materials and real recessed vents; do not expose or invent a living mouth. No new hidden rear/interior geometry or new profile. No forced frontalization, symmetrization, stretching or rotation from the selected source camera. No invented runes, letters, extra horns, tusks, holes, vents, or paint.

For A follow the actual source paint and neutral catalogue lighting where provided; do not create a new colourway. Preserve real sculpted relief and weathered finish, but do not add fictional microdetail to fake source resolution. One whole mask only, genuine transparent alpha, no floor, support, cast-shadow plane, labels/text/grid or duplicate. Request1254x1254square if supported; mask78–80percent of largest canvas axis with8–12percent clear margins all sides and no clipped edge. This is a documented photographed edition study, not canonical film-prop or human-art certification.
